import os, select, signal, subprocess, sys, time
# Fixture-owned helper. The child stays in this helper's session (no setsid), so the private
# pty can never become its controlling terminal (only a session leader without one can
# acquire a terminal); SIGHUP is also ignored in the child. Readiness is observed, not slept.
CONTROL = r"""
import os, select
os.write(1, b'EOF-READY\n')
p = select.poll(); p.register(0, select.POLLIN)
ev = p.poll()
try:
    d = os.read(0, 1); r = 'eof' if d == b'' else 'data'
except OSError as e:
    r = 'errno%d' % e.errno
open('control-detail', 'w').write('revents=%#x read=%s\n' % (ev[0][1], r))
open('control-read', 'w').write('poll-woke read-ended\n' if r in ('eof', 'errno5') else 'poll-woke read-' + r + '\n')
"""
CANDIDATE = ("tui init; printf 'EOF-READY\\n'; tui getkey > key; printf '%s\\n' \"$?\" > rc; "
             "tui end; printf 'end-returned\\n' > end")

def hup_ignored():
    signal.signal(signal.SIGHUP, signal.SIG_IGN)

def stat(pid):
    f = open('/proc/%d/stat' % pid).read().rsplit(')', 1)[1].split()
    return f[0], int(f[4])            # state, tty_nr

def syscall(pid):
    try:
        return open('/proc/%d/syscall' % pid).read().split()[0]
    except OSError:
        return None

def main(mode):
    out = []
    master, slave = os.openpty()
    rdev = os.fstat(slave).st_rdev
    mj, mn = os.major(rdev), os.minor(rdev)
    tty_nr = (mn & 0xff) | (mj << 8) | ((mn & ~0xff) << 12)
    argv = [sys.executable, '-c', CONTROL] if mode == 'control' else [mode, '--noprofile', '--norc', '-c', CANDIDATE]
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, close_fds=True,
                             preexec_fn=hup_ignored)
    os.close(slave)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 15
    seen, ready = b'', False
    while b'EOF-READY' not in seen and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if select.select([master], [], [], 0.1)[0]:
            try:
                seen += os.read(master, 4096)
            except OSError:
                break
    if b'EOF-READY' in seen:
        # Blocked in its input wait: state S on 5 consecutive samples 20 ms apart, with an
        # unchanged, non-running /proc syscall record where that file is readable.
        run, last, ctty = 0, None, None
        while run < 5 and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            try:
                state, ctty = stat(child.pid); sc = syscall(child.pid)
            except OSError:
                break
            ok = state == 'S' and sc != 'running' and (last is None or sc == last)
            run, last = (run + 1, sc) if ok else (0, None)
            time.sleep(0.02)
        ready = run >= 5
        out.append('private-pty-is-ctty %s' % ('yes' if ctty == tty_nr else 'no'))
    out.append('ready blocked' if ready else 'not-ready')
    os.close(master)
    out.append('master-closed')
    try:
        status = child.wait(timeout=10)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        child.kill(); status = child.wait(); out.append('killed-after-timeout')
    out.append('child-exit %d' % status)
    print('\n'.join(out))
    ok = ready and status == 0
    if mode == 'control':
        try:
            ok = ok and open('control-read').read() == 'poll-woke read-ended\n'
        except OSError:
            ok = False
    return 0 if ok else 1

sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1]))
